title: Protein Structure Viewer
description: A single-file, browser-based viewer for comparing, annotating and publishing predicted and experimental protein structures: AlphaFold confidence (pLDDT, PAE, ipTM), synchronized multi-view comparison, superposition with deviation colouring, PAE-derived and named domains, residue-property colour schemes, figure annotation, publication-quality PNG/SVG/TIFF export at stated print size and resolution, and self-contained interactive reports for reviewers. All processing happens in the browser; local files are never uploaded.
